checkedAlternates.risk: Trade secrets protect industrial formulas and algorithms like patents.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A trade secret relies on non-disclosure without public registration (group-1), whereas patents require public disclosure in exchange for exclusivity (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Geographical indications function like collective brand marks.
checkedAlternates.resolution: GIs tie product qualities to a specific geographic territory (group-2), distinct from individual commercial trademarks (group-4).
